name: Webform Paystack Field
description: Adds a Paystack payment field/handler to Webform, with server-side transaction verification.
project_description:
This module provides a custom Webform field type that enables seamless integration of the Paystack payment gateway with Webforms. With this feature, you can securely accept payments through Paystack directly within your Drupal Webforms.

 Use Case 

 The Webform Paystack Field module is ideal for scenarios where you need to integrate payment processing into your Webforms. For example:

 1. Accepting online payments for event registrations, donations, or product purchases through a Webform.

 2. Implementing a simple and secure payment flow for any Webform-based process using the Paystack payment gateway.

 This module streamlines payment processing by embedding Paystack functionality directly into your Webform, saving time and effort while providing a user-friendly payment experience.

 Requirements 

 To use this module, the following prerequisites must be met:

 • Webform Module: The Webform module must be installed and enabled on your Drupal site, as this module extends its functionality.

 • Paystack Account: A Paystack account is required to obtain the necessary API keys (public and private) for integration.

 Configuration Steps 

 To configure the Webform Paystack Field module, follow these steps:

 1. Install the Module.

 2. Provide Paystack API Keys:

 • Navigate to the module configuration page at /admin/config/user-interface/webform-paystack-field.

 • Enter your Paystack Public Key and Private Key obtained from your Paystack account dashboard. These keys are essential for connecting your Webform with the Paystack payment gateway.

 3. Add the Paystack Field to a Webform:

 • Open the Webform where you want to integrate the payment feature.

 • Add a new Webform field and select the field type provided by this module (e.g., “Paystack Payment Field”).

 • Configure the field settings as needed.
